Found apps/canvas/src/ops/radar.css. Look at it and find where the mode switch is styled and referenced.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && wc -l radar.css && grep -n -i -e 'mode' -e 'switch' -e 'overflow' radar.css | head -40 && grep -rIl --exclude-dir=node_modules -i 'radar.css' /work/apps/canvas/src | head"}

messages.content: Line 76 of radar.css sets .radar-modes to overflow: visible, which is why it no longer clips. Change it to hidden.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -i '76s/overflow: visible;/overflow: hidden;/' radar.css && sed -n '76p' radar.css"}
function.name: bash
